clips.title: The story
paras: Dazalar guides a night elf hunter through a second trial in Dolanaar. With an enchanted taming rod, you subdue a nightsaber stalker and learn how wild beasts differ.

Dazalar teaches you that the forest's creatures do not all behave alike. Each species has its own temperament, and a hunter must learn to meet it on its own terms. Beneath Teldrassil's canopy, the next test brings you against beasts more cunning and predatory than webspinners.

Kaldorei revere nightsabers as sacred predators, fierce guardians, and companions of the Sentinels. With the taming rod, you face a nightsaber stalker and must keep a steady nerve and calm authority. Winning its trust shows you can handle a predator, not only the more docile creatures of the woods.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The variance of nature is something that can be relied upon, friend. It is predictable in the way that it never remains the same; it is always changing.
The tasks I give to you will help you to see and appreciate the vast differences of the creatures you may choose as your companion.
Take this taming rod and use it to tame a nightsaber stalker, found to the south. Practice your skills as an adventurer. Then you will begin to understand the similarities and differences of nature.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Understanding the balance between nature and oneself is a way of life for every traveler.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I see your commitment and that you have understood what I have taught you, friend.
